theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (N W : Set (Euclid P)) (V : Set (Euclid d)) (ψ : Euclid d → Euclid P) (v₀ : Euclid d), IsOpen W → ContinuousOn ψ V → InjOn ψ V → ψ '' V = W ∩ N → (∀ K ⊆ W, IsCompact K → IsCompact (V ∩ ψ ⁻¹' K)) → v₀ ∈ V → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ closedBall (ψ v₀) ρ ⊆ W ∧ N ∩ closedBall (ψ v₀) ρ ⊆ ψ '' (V ∩ ball v₀ ε) ∧ IsCompact (N ∩ closedBall (ψ v₀) ρ)
